description: This file defines the 'BigTextMainActivity' class, an Android activity responsible for managing notification display in a wearable notification app. It cancels a notification and includes a placeholder for handling reminders from a database.

classes.name: BigTextMainActivity
classes.description: An Activity class for managing notification-based UI, specifically handling the cancellation of a notification upon creation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method invoked when the activity is created, sets the content view, and cancels the associated notification.
